text:
elena: heads up — ACME reported 429s right after midnight local time, but they were at ~40% of their monthly credits 15m earlier. customer says UI still shows 0 credits after wait. can we confirm reset behavior and any inflight retry double-draw?
ryan: do we have tenant id + timezone? any reconcile logs?
elena: tenant: acme-inc (tenant_id: t-acme-91). timezone: Europe/Zurich (CET now). customer attached request id from client: rq_0b2f7c9a.
support-bot: automated-alert: quota_depleted tenant=t-acme-91 at=2026-03-17T00:00:05Z peak_burst=4800tokens inflight_retries=6
samir: my guess — billing processed a prorate/top-up at 00:00 UTC but our UI cache invalidation runs on tenant-local-midnight job; for CET that job may be scheduled at 23:00 UTC (previous day) in rare config. need to check the refill job intervals. :thinking_face:
maria: to repro locally, can someone run the credits API around their local midnight and simulate 5 rapid retries? quick curl: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/t-acme-91/credits"``` that returns headers X-Remaining, X-Reset — capture those.
ryan: pulled logs: billing-service emitted a credit-topup event at 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z with amount=300000 tokens. but the serving layer accepted retries before the topup event reached cache — I see cache-get at 2026-03-16T23:59:58Z returned remaining=0. there were 6 retries between 23:59:58Z and 00:00:06Z, each got a 429.
elena: so looks like race: serving cache stale -> clients retried -> retries exhausted burst bucket -> even though billing topped up at 00:00:00Z, cache didn't reflect it until later.
samir: yep. also saw that the retry loop increments inflight counters that are billed as token usage in some heuristics (we should confirm double-counting). need to check if retry logs include successful tokens after topup or if they were all 429 and then re-sent later.
maria: can we get the sequence for rq_0b2f7c9a? extract the request/response headers.
ryan: sequence (abridged):
- 2026-03-16T23:59:58Z GET /credits -> X-Remaining: 0
- 2026-03-16T23:59:59Z POST /v1/generate -> 429 {"error":"quota_exceeded"} X-Request-Id: rq_0b2f7c9a
- 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z billing -> credit_topup processed (event id evt-7742)
- 2026-03-17T00:00:02Z cache refresh job -> tenant cache updated X-Remaining: 300000
- 2026-03-17T00:00:04Z client retried -> 200 ok tokens consumed 1500
so customer saw 429s for ~6s until cache refresh.
elena: customer expectation was instantaneous refill at midnight. suggests we need to document edge behavior: billing vs cache refresh lag and guidance for client retry backoff.
samir: mitigation options: 1) make billing emit a cache-warm event synchronously for tenant topups; 2) extend grace window to allow requests within Xs of topup to be retried without decrement; 3) add header hint X-Topup-Pending in 429 responses when topup event detected but cache stale.
maria: for this specific customer, propose we: (a) run an immediate reconcile job to ensure cache correctness, (b) issue a one-time credit to cover the inflight failed requests if they were double-billed, (c) update docs & notify acct team.
ryan: ran manual reconcile at 2026-03-17T00:10:10Z — cache now consistent. no evidence of double-billing in billing ledger: failed 429 requests were not billed, successful post-topup calls billed normally. customer likely saw UX gap but not charged extra.
elena: ok please confirm with support rep so we can close the ticket. also prod action items: samir to file infra ticket to add sync cache-warm on topup (priority P2) and maria to add a FAQ entry about midnight/topup race.
samir: filing INF-1429 with logs and suggestion.
maria: drafting FAQ: "Why did my credits show as zero for a few seconds after midnight?" will include repro steps and recommended client backoff (exponential with jitter, max 5s).
elena: ping @acct-team for customer communication: we offered a goodwill 10k token credit while we finalize infra change. please confirm. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: ticket tkt-9876 updated status=awaiting-acct-confirmation
elena: thanks all — closing thread once acct confirms messaging.
